note.zh: 第四阶段由隐藏事件 arcsite.1015 等权随机选择其一（已有对应考古标记时排除其他），地图中 1016→1017→1018 的先后连线是编译器把同一阶段的结果串联所致。
note.en: Stage 4 runs hidden arcsite.1015, which picks one at equal weight (archaeology flags exclude the others); the 1016→1017→1018 chain on the map is a compiler artefact.

notes.zh: 审阅说明：遗址定义带有生成权重（冰冻星球30、寒冷宜居星球5，max_instances = 1），也可在星系生成时出现；知名领袖纳苏兹·德墨忒尔的“虚空之语”只在该遗址尚未被发现时把它放到我们境内。
notes.en: Review note: the site has a spawn weight (30 on frozen worlds, 5 on cold habitable ones, max_instances = 1), so it can appear at galaxy generation; Nasuz Demetor's 'Voices in the Void' only places it in our space while it has not been found.

scope.zh: 已核对遗址定义（五个阶段、难度、可见条件、科学家要求）、阶段事件1000–1020、第四阶段随机分派1015、掷骰失败事件9000/9005及其后续。未完成：编译器把第四阶段的三个互斥结果串成先后（见请求3）。新建为独立遗址故事（原在 event-paragon-41234 内），分类为先驱者/考古，请协调者确认归属。
scope.en: Checked the site definition (5 stages, difficulty, visibility, scientist requirement), stage events 1000–1020, the stage-4 dispatcher 1015 and the roll-failure events 9000/9005 with follow-ups. Open: the compiler chains the three exclusive stage-4 results (Request 3). Created as its own site story (was inside event-paragon-41234), category precursors/archaeology — coordinator to confirm ownership.

uncertain: The generic dig incidents (ancrel.8000–8070, 13030) on roll failure are shared hubs and are only linked.
